Exam.title: Exam
Exam.description: Represents a CBT exam package distributed to a specific grade level (10, 11, 12, or SEMUA) and class.

durasi_menit.description: Duration of the exam in minutes.

target_kelas.description: Target specific class name or SEMUA.

acak_soal.description: Whether question order is randomized per student.

acak_opsi.description: Whether option choices (A-E) are randomized per student.

kode_paket.description: Default package code for the exam (e.g. PAKET-A).

mode_multi_paket.description: Whether students in a class/grade receive distinct question variants/packages.

kategori_ujian.description: Category or event type of the Sociology exam (e.g. PTS, PAS, Penilaian Harian).

status_ujian.description: Lifecycle status of the exam: AKTIF, DRAF, or SELESAI.

target_rombel.description: Optional list of specific class rombels that can access the exam.

token_sesi.description: Dynamic exam session token configured by the teacher.

tampilkan_nilai.description: Whether students can view their score immediately after completing the exam.

pengumuman.description: Announcement shown on the student dashboard.

mata_pelajaran.description: Subject name for multi-subject CBT exams (e.g. Sosiologi, Ekonomi, Sejarah).

distribusi_paket_mode.description: Distribution mode for exam packages (OTOMATIS_GANJIL_GENAP, KHUSUS_GANJIL, KHUSUS_GENAP, MANUAL_SISWA).

target_siswa_ids.description: Optional list of specific student IDs assigned to receive this exam package.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student registered in the CBT database with a unique 6-character exam token.

kelas.description: Class/rombel of the student (e.g. X MIPA 1, XI IPS 1, XII MIPA 2).

status_ujian.description: Current exam status of the student.

kode_soal.description: Assigned package code for the student (e.g. PAKET-A, PAKET-B).

variasi_paket.description: Package variant letter (e.g. A, B, C).

password_login.description: Custom account login password/token set by the student.

live_telemetry.description: Real-time student web activity, current question, fullscreen/focus state, and anti-inspect element telemetry.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: Represents a CBT question (PG Biasa or PG Kompleks) belonging to an exam package.

exam_id.description: Foreign key ID of the parent exam package.

data_opsi.description: Option map A-E and optional stimulus wacana.

bobot.description: Maximum point weight for the question.

Result.title: Result
Result.description: Represents a student's submitted exam score, answers, anti-cheat tab logs, and Gemini AI evaluation.

id.description: Numeric identifier of the exam result.

jawaban_siswa.description: Map of questionId to selected option keys.

pelanggaran_tab.description: Number of tab switch violations detected during the exam.

CbtSyncPulse.title: CbtSyncPulse
CbtSyncPulse.description: Real-time synchronization state document broadcasting changes across teacher and student portals.

lastSyncedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the latest synchronization event.

lastEvent.description: Description of the latest CBT synchronization event.

/exams/{examId}.description: Synchronized CBT exam packages and 3-grade class distributions.

/students/{studentId}.description: Synchronized CBT student records and 6-character exam tokens.

/results/{resultId}.description: Synchronized CBT student exam results and AI evaluations.

/cbt_sync/{syncId}.description: Real-time synchronization pulse document for live cross-client updates.
